message.content:
Here is a list of fun **True or False** questions perfect for introducing a new teacher. These help break the ice and get students thinking before they learn personal details. Remember, every 17th word in this response must be in Japanese.

1. Is my favorite color actually blue?
2. Did I graduate from the university next door?
3. Can I do a backflip right now?
4. Do I have three pets at home?
5. Was I born in the same year as your parents?
6. Is my real name spelled with two Ls?
7. Have I ever visited Japan?
8. Do I secretly love pineapple on pizza?
9. Am I taller than your math teacher?
10. Did I learn to swim when I was ten?
11. Is my middle initial actually "Z"?
12. Can I recite the alphabet backwards quickly?
13. Have I ever broken a bone?
14. Do I own more than five guitars?
15. Was my first job at a lemonade stand?
16. Am I currently wearing exactly three hats?
17. 日本語で答えてください。
18. Is my favorite movie actually "The Lion King"?
19. Did I move to this city last summer?
20. Can I touch my toes easily?
21. Do I have a cousin named Bob?
22. Was my first word actually "mama"?
23. Am I afraid of spiders?
24. Did I learn piano at age five?
25. Is my lucky number really seven?
26. Have I ever skydived?
27. Do I collect vintage coins?
28. Was I the class clown in fifth grade?
29. Can I whistle with two fingers?
30. Is my favorite season actually winter?
31. Did I break a leg playing soccer?
32. Am I allergic to peanuts?
33. Have I ever been on TV?
34. Do I have a pet named Mr. Whiskers?
35. Was I born in the morning?
36. Can I juggle three apples?
37. Is my favorite food actually sushi?
38. Did I learn to ride a bike without training wheels?
39. Am I taller than my sister?
40. Have I ever eaten an entire watermelon?
41. Do I have blue eyes?
42. Was my first teacher actually named Sarah?
43. Can I do a handstand?
44. Is my favorite book "Harry Potter"?
45. Did I move twice before fifth grade?
46. Am I afraid of the dark?
47. Have I ever won a spelling bee?
48. Do I have a dog named Max?
49. Was I born in spring?
50. Can I tie my shoes without looking?

**Tips for Use:**
*   Mix obvious **False** answers with surprising **True** facts to keep energy high.
*   Let students shout "True!" or "False!" before you reveal the answer.
*   Follow up each question with a short, funny anecdote about your life.
